components.name: Owner Primary Button
components.description: Owner-authorized primary action using cobalt, never runtime status.
components.css: .ds-button-owner { min-height: 34px; border: 1px solid #0f6cbd; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 10px; background: #0f6cbd; color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.45 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: background-color .16s cubic-bezier(.1,.9,.2,1); } .ds-button-owner:hover { border-color: #115ea3; background: #115ea3; } .ds-button-owner:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f6cbd; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-owner:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral bordered control for secondary operations.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 34px; border: 1px solid #c7c7c7; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 10px; background: #fff; color: #1f1f1f; font: 600 14px/1.45 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #ebebeb; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f6cbd; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact Fluent field with a strong neutral boundary and cobalt focus.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 260px; min-height: 34px; border: 1px solid #c7c7c7; border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 9px; background: #fff; color: #1f1f1f; caret-color: #0f6cbd; font: 400 14px/1.45 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #8a8a8a; } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: #0f6cbd; outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, #0f6cbd 24%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Workspace Tab
components.description: Compact workspace context with a cobalt Owner-selection underline.
components.css: .ds-workspace-tab { position: relative; min-width: 96px; height: 48px; display: grid; align-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0; padding: 5px 10px 7px; background: #f0f0f0; color: #1f1f1f; text-align: left; font: 600 13px/1.3 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-workspace-tab small { display: block; color: #616161; font-size: 11px; } .ds-workspace-tab::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 8px; bottom: 0; left: 8px; height: 2px; background: #0f6cbd; } .ds-workspace-tab:hover { background: #ebebeb; } .ds-workspace-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f6cbd; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Worker Dispatch Strip
components.description: One-column operational strip with a semantic state lamp and scan-first evidence.
components.css: .ds-worker-strip { position: relative; width: 440px; min-height: 76px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 3px 12px; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 14px 9px 28px; background: #fff; color: #424242; text-align: left; font: 400 13px/1.4 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-worker-strip > i { position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 11px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #0f7b6c; } .ds-worker-strip span { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-worker-strip small { color: #0f7b6c; } .ds-worker-strip strong { color: #1f1f1f; font-size: 14px; } .ds-worker-strip em { overflow: hidden; color: #424242; font-style: normal; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-worker-strip time { color: #616161; font-size: 11px; } .ds-worker-strip:hover { border-color: #c7c7c7; background: #e5f1fb; } .ds-worker-strip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f6cbd; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Direction seed d5a85ad0 resolves Praetorium as Fluent desktop foundations joined to a flight-dispatch strip workbench. Neutral planes, compact type, and one-pixel structure make long-running local work easy to scan; narrow status marks and chronological evidence provide the distinctive rhythm. This is an operating surface, not a dashboard gallery or terminal costume. Light is the default theme. Dark mode has full semantic and structural parity: it changes neutral values and contrast, never information architecture or color meaning. Cobalt identifies Owner selection and action; teal means active work, green means done, amber means waiting, and red means failure.
keyCharacteristics: A 52px command bar, resizable Director rail, workspace tabs, and one continuous workbench.
Compact one-column Worker dispatch strips instead of a card mosaic.
Independent scroll regions with the Director chat composer anchored at the bottom.
Flat neutral planes, one-pixel borders, 4–6px working corners, and shadow only on flyouts.
Segoe UI Variable Text for the interface and Cascadia Code only for machine-shaped content.
Light-first theming with complete dark-mode role parity.

rules.name: The Authority-Status Split Rule
rules.body: Cobalt means the Owner can select or act. Teal, green, amber, and red describe observed work state and never substitute for Owner authority.

rules.name: The Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Dark mode swaps token values, not roles, density, component placement, or status meaning.

rules.name: The Scan-First Type Rule
rules.body: Use the smallest established role that remains readable. Never add display scale to make an operational surface feel important.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Working surfaces stay flat. Only content that temporarily floats above the workbench may cast a shadow.

dos: Do preserve the 52px command bar, resizable 264px rail, explicit workspace tabs, and independent scroll ownership.
Do use cobalt only for Owner selection, focus, and actions; keep teal, green, amber, and red semantically distinct.
Do present active Workers as compact one-column dispatch strips beside their evidence and controls.
Do maintain the light-default and dark-parity token roles, visible keyboard focus, reduced motion, and 90–125% text scaling.
Do use one-pixel structure, 4–6px working corners, CSS/SVG icons, and plain operational labels.
donts: Don't turn the workbench into a card-dashboard mosaic or collections of floating summary tiles.
Don't imitate a terminal with monospace interface copy, neon color, command-line decoration, or black-on-black styling.
Don't add gradients, resting shadows, lifted hover transforms, inflated typography, excessive rounded cards, or decorative pills.
Don't add visible kickers above headings or use Unicode arrows to describe workflow.
Don't let the page shell scroll, unfix the Director composer, or merge Windows and WSL runtime identity.
